title: Border Bases and Border Basis Schemes
summary: This survey invites the readers on a journey spanning more than twenty years of research through the landscape of border basis schemes. During most of this period, I had the pleasure of working with Martin Kreuzer, and more recently with Le Ngoc Long. Along this journey, one encounters border bases, which are characterized by the remarkable property that their associated multiplication matrices commute pairwise. This property, in turn, provides a natural foundation for defining border basis schemes (BBS). These are beautiful schemes, elegantly defined by simple quadratic equations. However,…
